source: Derived from Isle of Man Government Climate Impact Assessment (CIA) Tool, version 15 April 2025

permanenceQuestion.text: Is this embedded in how your business operates year-round, or a one-off/occasional initiative?

options.label: Embedded in ongoing operations
One-off or occasional

reachQuestion.text: Does this effect extend beyond your own premises into the wider biosphere or community (supply chain, customers, habitats, neighbours)?

options.label: Yes — extends beyond our premises
No — limited to our premises

bands.action: Strong performance. Keep it up and consider sharing your approach with other biosphere businesses.
Positive contribution. Review whether it could be deepened or made permanent.
No impact identified. No action required.
Slight or short-term negative impact. Review this area to identify practical improvements.
Significant and/or long-term negative impact. Changes are needed in this area; prioritise it in your improvement plan.

criteria.name: Greenhouse Gases
criteria.question: How does your business affect greenhouse gas emissions and removals? Consider fuel and heating, vehicles, refrigeration, fertilisers/livestock, and anything that captures carbon (habitat creation, verified offsets).

options.label: We actively and measurably reduce emissions or increase carbon removals (e.g. renewable energy, electrified fleet, sequestration)
We take some steps that reduce our emissions
Not applicable / no material impact
Our operations slightly increase emissions
Our operations significantly increase emissions with no mitigation

criteria.name: Air Quality
criteria.question: How does your business affect air pollution, outdoors and indoors? Consider exhaust fumes, burning fuels, industrial processes, cooking emissions, and indoor air quality of your premises.

options.label: We significantly decrease air pollutants
We slightly decrease air pollutants
Not applicable / no material impact
We slightly increase air pollutants
We significantly increase air pollutants

criteria.name: Sustainable Transport
criteria.question: How does your business support the shift to sustainable transport for staff, customers, and deliveries? Consider active travel, public transport, EVs, charging points, bike racks, and delivery consolidation.

options.label: We significantly encourage sustainable transport
We slightly encourage sustainable transport
Not applicable / no material impact
We slightly discourage sustainable transport
We significantly discourage sustainable transport

criteria.name: Land Use Change
criteria.question: How does your business change the landscape and how land is used or maintained? Consider development footprint, surface permeability (concrete vs permeable surfaces), and green infrastructure such as trees or retention ponds.

options.label: Our land use significantly increases positive impacts
Our land use slightly increases positive impacts
Not applicable / no material impact
Our land use slightly increases negative impacts
Our land use significantly increases negative impacts

criteria.name: Biodiversity
criteria.question: How does your business affect plants, animals and habitats? Consider habitats on or near your site, key species, protected areas, land management, and pollution reaching soil or water.

options.label: We significantly improve biodiversity by restoring or creating habitats
We slightly improve biodiversity by improving habitats or supporting species
Not applicable / no material impact
We slightly reduce biodiversity through impacts on habitat quality or species
We significantly reduce biodiversity by reducing or replacing habitats

criteria.name: Soil, Watercourse & Marine Health
criteria.question: How does your business affect the health of soil, watercourses and the sea? Consider run-off, discharges, chemicals and fuels, plastic waste, and any activity on or near water.

options.label: We significantly decrease pollutants reaching soil or water
We slightly decrease pollutants reaching soil or water
Not applicable / no material impact
We slightly increase pollutants reaching soil or water
We significantly increase pollutants reaching soil or water

criteria.name: Climate Change Adaptation
criteria.question: How does your business affect resilience to climate impacts such as flooding, heat, drought and storms — for itself and its surroundings? Consider flood defences, shading, green roofs, water conservation and continuity planning.

options.label: We significantly increase resilience/adaptation
We slightly increase resilience/adaptation
Not applicable / no material impact
We slightly decrease resilience/adaptation
We significantly decrease resilience/adaptation

criteria.name: Energy Use
criteria.question: How does your business affect total energy demand? Consider building efficiency, insulation, appliances and lighting, heat pumps, operating hours, staff behaviour and digital/IT loads.

options.label: We significantly decrease our energy use
We slightly decrease our energy use
Not applicable / no material impact
We slightly increase our energy use
We significantly increase our energy use

criteria.name: Sustainable Materials
criteria.question: How sustainably does your business source materials and supplies? Consider certification, recycled/repurposed content, reusability, supply-chain transparency, ethical production, and embodied carbon.

options.label: Sustainable resources used throughout
Sustainable resources used in most places
Not applicable
Sustainable resources not used much
Sustainable resources not used or considered at all

criteria.name: Waste
criteria.question: How does your business affect the quantity and type of waste produced? Apply the waste hierarchy — prevent, reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, dispose — and include food waste, packaging, and waste water.

options.label: We significantly reduce overall quantities of waste
We slightly reduce overall quantities of waste
Not applicable / no material impact
We slightly increase overall quantities of waste
We significantly increase overall quantities of waste

criteria.name: Food
criteria.question: How does your business support access to healthy and affordable food in the community? Consider what you sell or serve, local sourcing, affordability, and support for food security initiatives.

options.label: We significantly promote healthy and/or affordable food
We slightly promote healthy and/or affordable food
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly impede healthy and/or affordable food
We significantly impede healthy and/or affordable food

criteria.name: Health & Wellbeing
criteria.question: How does your business affect physical and mental health — for staff, customers and the community? Consider working conditions, access to activity and nature, and services or products that support (or harm) health.

options.label: We significantly increase positive health outcomes
We slightly increase positive health outcomes
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly decrease positive health outcomes
We significantly decrease positive health outcomes

criteria.name: Housing
criteria.question: How does your business affect the availability, quality or affordability of housing? Consider staff accommodation, property you own or convert, short-term letting pressure, and support for energy-efficient homes.

options.label: We significantly increase access to quality and/or affordable homes
We slightly increase access to quality and/or affordable homes
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly decrease access to quality and/or affordable homes
We significantly decrease access to quality and/or affordable homes

criteria.name: Education & Skills
criteria.question: How does your business affect learning opportunities? Consider staff training, apprenticeships, work experience, community education, and skills that prepare people for a net-zero future.

options.label: We significantly increase the availability of learning opportunities
We slightly increase the availability of learning opportunities
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly decrease the availability of learning opportunities
We significantly decrease the availability of learning opportunities

criteria.name: Built Community
criteria.question: How does your business affect shared spaces, connectivity and sense of place? Consider green spaces, meeting places, links to paths and transport, and enabling community sustainability through the built environment.

options.label: We significantly improve facilities, shared spaces, connectivity or resources
We slightly improve facilities, shared spaces, connectivity or resources
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly reduce facilities, shared spaces, connectivity or resources
We significantly reduce facilities, shared spaces, connectivity or resources

criteria.name: Cultural Community
criteria.question: How does your business affect the social and cultural life of the community? Consider support for local events, arts, sport, heritage, minority languages, and community climate action.

options.label: We significantly increase social or cultural resources or support
We slightly increase social or cultural resources or support
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly reduce social or cultural resources or support
We significantly reduce social or cultural resources or support

criteria.name: Accessibility
criteria.question: How accessible is your business? Consider physical access for disabled people, digital access, social barriers such as language or isolation, and financial barriers.

options.label: We actively reduce barriers to increase access
We present no barriers to access
Not applicable / no impact
There is a risk of some barriers to access
We present barriers to access in one or more areas

criteria.name: Local Economy & Jobs
criteria.question: How does your business support local livelihoods? Consider local employment and procurement, quality of employment (living wage, secure contracts), and opportunities such as tourism, apprenticeships or new services.

options.label: We provide significant support for the local economy and/or employment
We provide slight support for the local economy and/or employment
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly undermine the local economy and/or employment
We significantly undermine the local economy and/or employment

criteria.name: Safety
criteria.question: How does your business affect safety and risk of harm? Consider premises safety, lighting and 'eyes on the street', traffic generated, product/service safety, and cyber security of customer data.

options.label: We significantly increase safety and/or reduce risk of harm
We slightly increase safety and/or reduce risk of harm
Not applicable / no impact
We slightly decrease safety and/or increase risk of harm
We significantly decrease safety and/or increase risk of harm

criteria.name: Equity
criteria.question: Does your business treat all groups fairly? Consider whether any group — by age, disability, income, race, gender, caring responsibilities, location, or access to technology — is differentially affected by how you operate, price, or hire.

options.label: No groups differentially impacted, and we actively promote safeguards
No groups differentially impacted
Not applicable / no impact
Some groups differentially impacted, but safeguards are in place
Some groups differentially impacted

criteria.name: Community Voice
criteria.question: How are the community and your staff involved in business decisions that affect them? Consider consultation on changes to premises or services, staff involvement, and engagement with local groups.

options.label: Significant opportunities for involvement in and influence on our decisions
Some engagement, with opportunities for involvement or consultation
Not applicable / no impact
Advisory engagement only, with no opportunities for involvement
No communication or engagement
